api.name: 有報LAB
api.description: 有報LAB (YuhoLAB): data on Japanese listed companies, extracted from annual securities reports (有価証券報告書) and other filings published on EDINET by Japan's Financial Services Agency. Start with search_companies to resolve a 4-digit ticker code (e.g. 7203), then call the per-company tools. Amounts are in yen (not thousands or millions), per-share values are in yen, share counts are in shares, and ratios are percent unless a response says otherwise. Figures are processed from the original filings and may differ from them; check EDINET for the source documents. Information only, not investment advice. All tools are read-only.

endpoints.description: Search listed issuers by ticker code or company name. Returns code, name, market, sector and location for each match.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search query (ticker code or company name).

endpoints.description: EDINET document list for an issuer, including doc_id values used by filing-content.

parameters.name: max_years
parameters.description: How many years of filings to return (default 5).

endpoints.description: Annual financial summary (levels such as sales, operating_profit and net_profit). Amounts in yen (not thousands or millions); ratios in percent.

parameters.name: years
parameters.description: How many years of summary to return.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response keys to include (e.g. sales,operating_profit,net_profit).

200.description: Financial summary, proxied unchanged. Must-preserve JSON keys: sales, operating_profit, net_profit.

sales.description: Sales / revenue. Amount in yen. Gateway must not rename this key.

operating_profit.description: Operating profit. Amount in yen. Gateway must not rename this key.

net_profit.description: Net profit. Amount in yen. Gateway must not rename this key.

endpoints.description: Year-over-year factor decomposition (waterfall) for the same levels as financials.

parameters.name: years
parameters.description: How many years of waterfall to return.

endpoints.description: Section text from an EDINET filing. doc_id is optional; when omitted, the latest annual report is used.

parameters.name: doc_id
parameters.description: EDINET document id. Optional; omit for the latest annual report.

parameters.name: sections
parameters.description: Comma-separated section keys. Omit for all sections.

endpoints.description: Short company description for an issuer (stored data only).

Business relations disclosed in annual reports (stored data only): major customers, group companies (parent / subsidiary / affiliate), strategic shareholdings (investee) and major shareholders, plus reverse lookups from other listed companies' reports (supplier, major_shareholder_of). Each row cites its source filing. Amounts in JPY; voting_ratio in percent.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Comma-separated: customer, supplier, group, parent, subsidiary, affiliate, investee, major_shareholder, major_shareholder_of. Omit for all types.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: next_cursor from the previous response. Only valid with the same type.

endpoints.description: Structured breakdown from an annual report, by axis: segment (reportable segments: external sales, profit, assets, capital expenditures and headcount per segment) or geography (sales by region). Amounts in JPY (raw tagged values, not rounded); headcount in persons. segment_structure says single or multiple. The former employees axis is folded into segment: each row has an employees cell and the employees block lists the headcount table. Rounding-level gaps are omitted from the difference row.

parameters.name: doc_id
parameters.description: EDINET document id. Optional; omit for the latest annual report.

endpoints.description: Multi-year series of one reportable-segment metric, newest first, default 5 years. Each year has segments, adjustment, consolidated, and a difference row only beyond rounding tolerance. Row prior links use connect/rename/reorg/break with basis; year line_cut tells iOS to break the line. Amounts in raw tagged yen. Missing years are omitted, not filled.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: segment_key to keep that line across years (rename chain included). Alias: segment_key.

parameters.name: years
parameters.description: How many years to return. Default 5.

parameters.name: fiscal_year
parameters.description: Single year (YYYY or fy_end). Overrides years. Missing year is omitted (404 if none).

endpoints.description: Full BS/PL/CF/SS statement items for an issuer (stored data only).

parameters.name: years
parameters.description: How many years of statements to return.

endpoints.description: EPS, diluted EPS, BPS and issued shares as disclosed in the annual report (items keyed eps / diluted_eps / bps / issued_shares, among others). Replaces the retired statement/notes route.

parameters.name: doc_id
parameters.description: EDINET document id. Optional; omit for the latest annual report.

endpoints.description: Recent listed-company filings across issuers, newest first.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return.

endpoints.description: Screen listed issuers by financial conditions. Private for now: allowlisted at the gateway for the first-party app, not published in OpenAPI, skills or MCP tools.
Every screen_index row in columnar form, for on-device screening in the iOS app. Supports conditional GET. Private: allowlisted at the gateway but not published in OpenAPI, skills or MCP tools.
